summary.description: One ultracave line <=120 chars: counts + key risk only, zero praise.

location.description: WHERE it is wrong: path/to/file:line or path/to/file:start-end

bug.description: WHAT is wrong: 1 concise line, concrete failure scenario (input/state -> wrong result)

expected.description: EXPECTED correct behavior: 1 line, observable result for the same scenario (status code, value, state)

fix.description: HOW to fix: <=4 lines, exact shared function + root-cause change

test.description: Exact test function name + assertion that proves the expected behavior
